name: Estante de puertas ranuradas con patas
adaptations: legs drawn 170 mm tall: at the 1350 mm height that keeps the back panel in one board (with shorter legs it is longer than the usable sheet and comes in two)
V legs drawn as a leg at each corner
material assumed T18 pine plywood; facing is the same ply
doors read as inset from the thin reveals; overlay would be the other reading
vertical microgrooves on the doors drawn as vertical router grooves
the doors show no pull in the photos: a finger notch is drawn so the inset doors can be opened
notes: Estante de triplay de pino con tres columnas y dos niveles de puertas ranuradas, una hoja por hueco; detrás de cada puerta hay un entrepaño, y descansa sobre dos patas en V.
